en.title: Payers
en.summary: Employers and insurers that pay for some patients' care. A patient is linked to their payer on registration, and that patient's bills go to the payer unless the desk chooses otherwise.

sections.heading: The columns
sections.body: Name, phone, email and TIN, who added the payer, and when. Click a name to open the payer: their bills, what they owe, and taking their payment.

sections.heading: Adding a payer
sections.body: Press Add a payer. A new payer waits for someone else to approve it in Approvals → Payers before it can be chosen.

am.title: ከፋዮች
am.summary: ለአንዳንድ ታካሚዎች ሕክምና የሚከፍሉ አሠሪዎችና መድን ሰጪዎች። ታካሚ ሲመዘገብ ከከፋዩ ጋር ይገናኛል፤ የዚያ ታካሚ ደረሰኞች ባለሙያው ሌላ ካልመረጠ ወደ ከፋዩ ይሄዳሉ።

sections.heading: ዓምዶቹ
sections.body: ስም፣ ስልክ፣ ኢሜይልና TIN፣ ከፋዩን ማን እንደጨመረውና መቼ። ከፋዩን ለመክፈት ስሙን ይጫኑ፦ ደረሰኞቹ፣ ያለበት ዕዳና ክፍያውን መቀበል።

sections.heading: ከፋይ መጨመር
sections.body: "Add a payer"ን ይጫኑ። አዲስ ከፋይ ከመመረጡ በፊት ሌላ ሰው በApprovals → Payers እስኪያጸድቀው ይጠብቃል።
